Team — quick read on the redlines and recommended position:

Summary of risk items from Stratix redline:
1) Liability cap: customer wants USD 5,000,000 (or formula tied to fees). Our standard: USD 1,000,000 (or 12 months fees cap).
2) Indemnity: request for unlimited indemnity for IP claims and very broad third-party indemnities.
3) Warranty: 90 days for services (we typically do 30 days for warranty of services).
4) Data access/audit: request for log access and audit rights (need narrow scope).

Recommendation:
- Liability cap: offer USD 2,000,000 or the greater of USD 2,000,000 or 12 months fees, but include a separate carveout for willful misconduct and bodily injury where we cannot cap liability (standard language).
- Indemnity: push back on unlimited indemnity. Accept mutual indemnity for IP infringement (subject to our standard limitations) and carve out consequential damages. No open-ended customer indemnity for general third-party claims.
- Warranty: accept 90-day warranty for identified deliverables in the SOW only (not for ongoing model outputs); keep service credit approach for SLA.
- Data/audit: propose an alternative limited audit right (quarterly, scoped, with NDAs and observation-only).

Why escalation needed: the liability cap increase to USD 2M+ is beyond Deal Desk approval thresholds. Also the redline around indemnity (as requested) is not acceptable without exec authorization.

Requested approval ask (from exec):
- Approve counter of USD 2,000,000 liability cap (or 2x annual fees up to 2M) and the indemnity language we propose (mutual IP indemnity only).
- Approve limited warranty to 90 days for SOW deliverables.

If exec approves, I will prepare a clean counter-mark (counter_terms_STRX_20260930.docx) for Lukas to send back to Stratix.

Monica Patel
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
